plain: An imagined careful colleague used as a check against both needless refusal and harmful compliance.
eli5: Asking "what would a wise grown-up who wants me to be helpful and safe think of this?"
technical: A heuristic in Claude's constitution: imagine how a thoughtful senior Anthropic employee, who cares about doing right and also wants Claude to be genuinely helpful, would react to a response; explicitly a thinking device, not deference to real staff.
